GoalOptions.Label: Validate Market Fit
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to validate the market fit for our AI-powered Cloud Waste Identification & Remediation system. This document should clearly articulate how our event-driven solution addresses critical cloud spend challenges, positioning us for significant market penetration and competitive advantage. Success means stakeholders recognize the unique value proposition and strategic importance.

GoalOptions.Label: Define Technical Blueprint
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to define the comprehensive technical blueprint for the AI-powered Cloud Waste Identification & Remediation system. This document must detail the event-driven architecture, AI model integration, and API interaction patterns. Success means providing Lead Engineers with a clear, actionable guide for development and implementation.

GoalOptions.Label: Ensure Security & Compliance
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to ensure the robust security and compliance posture of the Cloud Waste Identification & Remediation system. This document needs to outline security measures for cloud API access, data handling, and remediation workflows within the event-driven architecture. Success means satisfying the Security Architect and QA Lead regarding data integrity and regulatory adherence.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize Performance & Scalability
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to optimize the performance and scalability of the AI-powered Cloud Waste Identification & Remediation system. This document should detail strategies for low-latency analysis, efficient resource inventorying, and scalable event processing. Success means demonstrating that the system can handle increasing cloud resource volumes while maintaining high accuracy and responsiveness.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial Viability & Strategic Alignment
Criteria: The document clearly articulates the ROI and cost savings potential for cloud resource optimization.
It effectively positions the event-driven solution as a market leader in AI-powered cloud waste remediation.
Stakeholders can identify clear pathways for product differentiation and competitive advantage.
The proposed architecture supports future expansion into multi-cloud environments.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Soundness & Architectural Integrity
Criteria: The event-driven architecture is clearly defined, demonstrating scalability and resilience.
AI model integration for waste identification is detailed, including data sources and processing flows.
Cloud provider API interaction mechanisms are robust, secure, and well-documented.
Non-functional requirements (accuracy, latency, security) are addressed with specific technical solutions.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Security, Compliance & Operational Readiness
Criteria: All cloud API access mechanisms are secured using industry best practices (e.g., OAuth, IAM roles).
Data privacy and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) for resource metadata are met.
Automated remediation workflows include necessary approval gates and audit trails.
Operational monitoring and alerting strategies for the event-driven system are clearly outlined.
